say:2:1510718001:0.text: ... Oh no, the shapeshifting spell wore off.

say:3:1510718002:0.text: Fine by me. The disguises were only slowing us down.
say:3:1510718002:0.source_cn: 正合我意。呼临人的姿态不方便行动。

say:4:1510718003:0.text: I see that Halian soldier just up ahead, on higher ground.
say:4:1510718003:0.source_cn: 那个呼临士兵就在前方，在高处。

say:5:1510718004:0.text: There's a cliff face up ahead we can climb.
say:5:1510718004:0.source_cn: 前面有一处崖壁，可以攀爬上去。

say:6:1510718005:0.text: He's still there? And what about Perseus and his troops?
say:6:1510718005:0.source_cn: 他还没有离开？珀尔修斯和其他士兵是不是也在？

say:7:1510718006:0.text: I don't hear that many people.
say:7:1510718006:0.source_cn: 没听到那么多人的声音。

choice_prompt:8:1510718003.text: I see that Halian soldier just up ahead, on higher ground.
choice_prompt:8:1510718003.source_cn: 那个呼临士兵就在前方，在高处。

say:9:1510718007:0.text: We can't just stand around here. We have to protect Wrathwood Grove.
say:9:1510718007:0.source_cn: 我们不能停在这里，必须保护树怒山谷。

say:10:1510718008:0.text: Of course. Follow me, Divine One.
say:10:1510718008:0.source_cn: 当然。跟在我身后，神明大人。
say:10:1510718008:0.male: Of course. Follow me, Divine One.
say:10:1510718008:0.female: Of course. Follow me, Divine One.

choice:8:0:1.text: Could be an ambush. Stay sharp.
choice:8:0:1.male: Could be an ambush. Stay sharp.
choice:8:0:1.female: Could be an ambush. Stay sharp.

choice:8:1:2.text: I'm guessing he "accidentally" fell behind again.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 恐怕他又“不小心”掉队了
choice:8:1:2.male: I'm guessing he "accidentally" fell behind again.
choice:8:1:2.female: I'm guessing he "accidentally" fell behind again.
